opening.argument: The video gives members a direct instruction to place Bitcoin into a Trading Pool, declaring that “The only place your bitcoin can work for you is in the Trading Pool account.” It then walks them through moving funds from an Activation Wallet and entering the amount and login password, presenting the transfer as an increase in the back-office balance. The dashboard reinforces the investment-and-recruitment structure by displaying binary, trading, and referral bonuses, including an entry labeled “Referral Bonus.” This is guidance to commit funds to Mirror Trading International's Trading Pool, an investment program later found fraudulent by a federal court in a CFTC case, rather than an independent investigation.
